title: Finite-type quasi-coherent submodules extend across a qc open
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] which is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $U\subseteq X$ be an open subscheme which is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. For an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal M$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and an open $W\subseteq X$ write $\mathcal M|_W$ for its restriction ($\mathcal M|_W(T)=\mathcal M(T)$ for opens $T\subseteq W$); a *submodule* $\mathcal G\subseteq\mathcal M$ is a sub-$\mathcal O_X$-module, i.e. $\mathcal G(T)\subseteq\mathcal M(T)$ is an $\mathcal O_X(T)$-submodule for every open $T$, compatibly with restriction, and $\mathcal G$ is a sheaf. Let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent] and let $\mathcal G\subseteq\mathcal F|_U$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_U$-submodule which is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. Then there is a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-submodule $\mathcal G'\subseteq\mathcal F$ of finite type with $\mathcal G'|_U=\mathcal G$ as submodules of $\mathcal F|_U$, i.e. $\mathcal G'(T)=\mathcal G(T)$ for every open $T\subseteq U$.

proof.text: Put r = j followed by psi and take its abelian image in F. The image is quasi-coherent and finite type by the existing image theorems. Restricted to U, r is the prescribed monomorphism preceded by the isomorphism j.over U followed by alpha. The restricted factorThruImage is therefore monic; open restriction preserves its epimorphicity. In the abelian category it is an isomorphism. Compose its inverse with j.over U and alpha to construct the required e, and cancel the restricted factorThruImage to verify compatibility with the inclusion.

theorem exists_quasicoherent_finiteType_submodule_extension
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (G : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
    [G.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsFiniteType]
    (ι : G ⟶ F.over U) [Mono ι] :
    ∃ (G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)),
      G'.IsQuasicoherent ∧ G'.IsFiniteType ∧
        ∃ (ι' : G' ⟶ F), Mono ι' ∧ ∃ (e : G'.over U ≅ G),
          (SheafOfModules.overFunctor (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).map ι' = e.hom ≫ ι
